simple.meaning: מַחֲוִים (Machăvîym) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Machavite or inhabitant of some place named Machaveh.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַחֲוִים (H4233) before moving outward to related references.
